## [About][Top]

**Masque: Entropy** is an add-on for [World of Warcraft] that adds a set of skins for [Masque].

## [Skins][Top]

This set is based on [Apathy] and includes a number of metallic skins in the following ore colors:

- Adamantite
- Bronze
- Cobalt
- Copper
- Fel Iron
- Gold
- Iron
- Khorium
- Obsidium
- Saronite
- Silver
- Titanium

## [Requirements][Top]

This add-on requires [Masque].

## [Installation][Top]

Install the package through your preferred add-on manager or extract the archive to your add-ons directory.

## [Credits][Top]

- [Zeal](https://www.curseforge.com/members/zealvurte) for the original **Vol** skin.

## [Feedback][Top]

For bug reports and suggestions, use the [issue tracker]. Direct any questions or comments to [Discord].

## [Localization][Top]

To help translate this add-on, use the [localization system]. Alternatively, you can use the [issue tracker].
